adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَقُولُ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَعَلَى دِينِي وَعَلَى أَهْلِي وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي وَعَلَى مَالِي وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِي وَعَلَى أَدْيَانِهِمْ وَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ
adhkar.translation: A thousand times, in the name of Allah. Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. I declare this over myself, over my religion, over my family, over my children, over my wealth, over my companions, and over their religion and their wealth.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāh, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, aqūlu ʿalā nafsī wa-ʿalā dīnī wa-ʿalā ahlī wa-ʿalā awlādī wa-ʿalā mālī wa-ʿalā aṣḥābī wa-ʿalā adyānihim wa-ʿalā amwālihim.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَلْفَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَقُولُ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَعَلَى دِينِي وَعَلَى أَهْلِي وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي وَعَلَى مَالِي وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِي وَعَلَى أَدْيَانِهِمْ وَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ
adhkar.translation: A thousand thousand times, in the name of Allah. Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. I declare this over myself, over my religion, over my family, over my children, over my wealth, over my companions, and over their religion and their wealth.
adhkar.transliteration: Alfa bismi Llāh, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, aqūlu ʿalā nafsī wa-ʿalā dīnī wa-ʿalā ahlī wa-ʿalā awlādī wa-ʿalā mālī wa-ʿalā aṣḥābī wa-ʿalā adyānihim wa-ʿalā amwālihim.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَلْفَ أَلْفِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَقُولُ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَعَلَى دِينِي وَعَلَى أَهْلِي وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي وَعَلَى مَالِي وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِي وَعَلَى أَدْيَانِهِمْ وَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ
adhkar.translation: A thousand thousand times, in the name of Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. I declare this over myself, over my religion, over my family, over my children, over my wealth, over my companions, and over their religion and their wealth.
adhkar.transliteration: Alfa alfi bismi Llāh, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, aqūlu ʿalā nafsī wa-ʿalā dīnī wa-ʿalā ahlī wa-ʿalā awlādī wa-ʿalā mālī wa-ʿalā aṣḥābī wa-ʿalā adyānihim wa-ʿalā amwālihim.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَلْفَ أَلْفِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: A thousand thousand times, there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent.
adhkar.transliteration: Alfa alfi lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَبِاللَّهِ وَمِنَ اللَّهِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ وَفِي اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, and by Allah, and from Allah, and to Allah, and upon Allah, and in Allah. And there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi, wa-bi-Llāhi, wa-mina Llāhi, wa-ilā Llāhi, wa-ʿalā Llāhi, wa-fī Llāhi, wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى دِينِي وَعَلَى نَفْسِي وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي
adhkar.translation: “In the name of Allah” over my religion, over myself, and over my children.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi ʿalā dīnī wa-ʿalā nafsī wa-ʿalā awlādī.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَالِي وَعَلَى أَهْلِي
adhkar.translation: “In the name of Allah” over my wealth and over my family.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi ʿalā mālī wa-ʿalā ahlī.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَعْطَانِيهِ رَبِّي
adhkar.translation: “In the name of Allah” over everything that my Lord has given me.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi ʿalā kulli shay'in aʿṭānīhi Rabbī.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the seven earths, and Lord of the Mighty Throne.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi Rabbi s-samāwāti s-sabʿi wa-Rabbi l-araḍīna s-sabʿi wa-Rabbi l-ʿarshi l-ʿAẓīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth nor in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi lladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa smihi shay'un fī l-arḍi wa-lā fī s-samā'i wa-huwa s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَفِي السَّمَاءِ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the best of names in the earth and in heaven.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi khayri l-asmā'i fī l-arḍi wa-fī s-samā'.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَفْتَتِحُ وَبِهِ أَخْتَتِمُ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah I begin, and with Him I conclude.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi aftatiḥu wa-bihi akhtatim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ
adhkar.translation: Allah, Allah, Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāh, Allāh, Allāh.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
adhkar.translation: Allah is my Lord, I associate no partner unto Him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhu Rabbī lā ushriku bihi shay'a.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
adhkar.translation: Allah is my Lord, there is no deity except Allah.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhu Rabbī lā ilāha illā Llāh.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ وَأَجَلُّ وَأَكْبَرُ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ
adhkar.translation: Allah is mightier, more majestic, and greater than what I fear and guard against.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhu aʿazzu wa-ajallu wa-akbaru mimmā akhāfu wa-aḥdhar.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَيْرِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ رَبِّي وَذَرَأَ وَبَرَأَ
adhkar.translation: By You, O Allah, I seek refuge from the evil of myself, and from the evil of others, and from the evil of what my Lord has created, brought forth, and originated.
adhkar.transliteration: Bika Llāhumma aʿūdhu min sharri nafsī, wa-min sharri ghayrī, wa-min sharri mā khalaqa Rabbī wa-dhara'a wa-bara'a.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَحْتَرِزُ مِنْهُمْ
adhkar.translation: By You, O Allah, I guard myself against them.
adhkar.transliteration: Bika Llāhumma aḥtarizu minhum.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَبِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
adhkar.translation: And by You, O Allah, I seek refuge from their evils.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-bika Llāhumma aʿūdhu min shurūrihim.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَبِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَدْرَأُ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ
adhkar.translation: And by You, O Allah, I drive them back at their necks.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-bika Llāhumma adra'u fī nuḥūrihim.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَأُقَدِّمُ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ
adhkar.translation: And I put forward before me and before them.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-uqaddimu bayna yadayya wa-aydīhim.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ يَمِينِي وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ شِمَالِي وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِهِمْ وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَمَامِي وَأَمَامِهِمْ وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ خَلْفِي وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ فَوْقِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ تَحْتِي وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ وَمِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مُحِيطٌ بِي وَبِهِمْ
adhkar.translation: And likewise (the Basmala and Surah al-Ikhlas) from my right and from their right hands, and likewise from my left and from their left sides, and likewise from before me and before them, and likewise from behind me and from behind them, and likewise from above me and from above them, and likewise from beneath me and from beneath them, and likewise encompassing me and them.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-mithla dhalika ʿan yamīnī wa-aymānihim, wa-mithla dhalika ʿan shimālī wa-ʿan shamā'ilihim, wa-mithla dhalika ʿan amāmī wa-amāmihim, wa-mithla dhalika min khalfī wa-min khalfihim, wa-mithla dhalika min fawqī wa-min fawqihim, wa-mithla dhalika min taḥtī wa-min taḥtihim, wa-mithla dhalika muḥīṭun bī wa-bihim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ لِي وَلَهُمْ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ بِخَيْرِكَ الَّذِي لَا يَمْلِكُهُ غَيْرُكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for myself and for them from Your goodness, by Your goodness which none besides You possesses.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka lī wa-lahum min khayrika bi-khayrika lladhi lā yamlikuhu ghayruk.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي وَإِيَّاهُمْ فِي عِبَادِكَ وَعِيَاذِكَ وَجَوَارِكَ وَأَمَانِكَ وَحِزْبِكَ وَحِرْزِكَ وَكَنَفِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَسُلْطَانٍ وَإِنْسٍ وَجَانٍّ وَبَاغٍ وَحَاسِدٍ وَسَبُعٍ وَحَيَّةٍ وَعَقْرَبٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, place me and them among Your servants, in Your refuge, Your protection, Your security, Your party, Your fortress, and Your shelter, from the evil of every devil, oppressor, human, jinn, transgressor, envier, beast, snake, and scorpion, and from the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold. Indeed, my Lord is upon a straight path.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma jʿalnī wa-iyyāhum fī ʿibādika wa-ʿiyādhika wa-jawārika wa-amānika wa-ḥizbika wa-ḥirzika wa-kanafika, min sharri kulli shayṭānin wa-sulṭānin wa-insin wa-jānnin wa-bāghin wa-ḥāsidin wa-sabuʿin wa-ḥayyatin wa-ʿaqrabin, wa-min sharri kulli dābbatin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatihā, inna Rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْمَرْبُوبِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Lord is sufficient for me against those under His lordship.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya r-Rabbu mina l-marbūbīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ الْخَالِقُ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Creator is sufficient for me against the created beings.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya l-Khāliqu mina l-makhlūqīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ الرَّازِقُ مِنَ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Provider is sufficient for me against those who are provided for.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya r-Rāziqu mina l-marzūqīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ السَّاتِرُ مِنَ الْمَسْتُورِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Concealer is sufficient for me against those who are concealed.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya s-Sātiru mina l-mastūrīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ النَّاصِرُ مِنَ الْمَنْصُورِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Helper is sufficient for me against those who are helped.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya n-Nāṣiru mina l-manṣūrīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ الْقَاهِرُ مِنَ الْمَقْهُورِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Subduer is sufficient for me against those who are subdued.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya l-Qāhiru mina l-maqhūrīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ حَسْبِي
adhkar.translation: He who is sufficient for me is my sufficiency.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya lladhī huwa ḥasbī.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ مَنْ لَمْ يَزَلْ حَسْبِي
adhkar.translation: Sufficient for me is the One who has never ceased to be sufficient for me.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya man lam yazal ḥasbī.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
adhkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya Llāhu wa-niʿma l-wakīl.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ
adhkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for me against all of His creation.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya Llāhu min jamīʿi khalqih.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
adhkar.translation: And may Allah send prayers upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family and companions, and grant them peace.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-ṣallā Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallam.

adhkar.text_arabic: خَبَأْتُ نَفْسِي فِي خَزَائِنِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَقْفَالُهَا ثِقَتِي بِاللَّهِ مَفَاتِيحُهَا لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ أُدَافِعُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَنْ نَفْسِي مَا أُطِيقُ وَمَا لَا أُطِيقُ لَا طَاقَةَ لِمَخْلُوقٍ مَعَ قُدْرَةِ الْخَالِقِ
adhkar.translation: I have placed myself within the treasures of ‘In the name of Allah.’ Their locks are my trust in Allah, and their keys are ‘there is no power except through Allah.’ By You, O Allah, I defend myself against what I am able to withstand and what I am unable to withstand. No created being has any power alongside the power of the Creator.
adhkar.transliteration: Khaba'tu nafsī fī khazā'ini bismi Llāh, aqfāluhā thiqatī bi-Llāh, mafātiḥuhā lā quwwata illā bi-Llāh, udāfiʿu bika Llāhumma ʿan nafsī mā uṭīqu wa-mā lā uṭīq, lā ṭāqata li-makhlūqin maʿa qudrati l-khāliq.

adhkar.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
adhkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best disposer of affairs. And there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent. And may Allah send prayers upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family and his companions, and grant them peace.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥasbiya Llāhu wa-niʿma l-wakīl, wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm, wa-ṣallā Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallam.
